name: dsh-turn-artifacts
description: Web GUI plugin with two independent jobs: it makes inline-code file mentions clickable when the file was produced indirectly by a terminal command (a python-pptx .pptx, a matplotlib .png, an ffmpeg .mp4) rather than by the write/edit tools; and it fills a Session's history window on open, so a fresh page load shows more than the newest 50 messages.

scripts.test: node test/host.mjs && node test/autofill-off.mjs && node test/harness.mjs
